reason: Modelled as a selfPowered open-drain pulse-sensor (1 pulse per wheel revolution, rpm control, short closure duty 0.95) with a debounced IRQ driver that averages the period between closures; check passed on ESP32 and Pico (240 rpm on 2096 mm wheel prints Speed=30 km/h).
